title: Quickstart (2026) Origami hero + step accordion assets (compact quickstart)
author: Avery Chen
body:
h1. Overview
This page documents the final design spec and handoff package for the compact “Origami” hero and paired step accordion pattern used on the Quickstart landing page.

The hero is a space-efficient layout that communicates Redwood Inference’s core value (fast, predictable inference) using a kinetic fold/expand motif. The step accordion provides accessible, keyboard-friendly step-by-step onboarding.

h1. Scope and goals
*Primary goals*
* Reduce above-the-fold height on enterprise consoles where vertical real estate is constrained.
* Communicate “predictable latency” and “fast time-to-first-inference” with a compact, animated visual.
* Provide an onboarding pattern (accordion) that is accessible by default and robust on small screens.

*Out of scope*
* Copywriting beyond final hero headline/subhead and CTA labels (handled by PM/content).
* Net-new onboarding steps content (steps are examples; engineering owns final step content).

h1. Final decisions (updates vs earlier drafts)
* Motion delivery: We are *not shipping Lottie* for the hero. The final spec uses *CSS transforms + opacity* only (engineering preference to minimize JS-driven animation and reduce bundle risk).
* Keyboard shortcut: The optional “press k to jump to steps” enhancement was *removed* to avoid conflicts with existing console shortcuts. Navigation relies on standard focus order and in-page anchor only.
* Accordion animation: Mobile reflow issues observed during spike were resolved by switching to a Web Animations API approach that measures content height once on expand (with a fallback to max-height transition). This reduces layout thrash on narrow screens.
* Performance budget: Hero micro-animations must remain under a *40ms* jank budget on the standard Dedicated demo machine profile (updated from 50ms after perf pass).

h1. Deliverables
h2. Figma
* High-fidelity frames for desktop/tablet/mobile.
* Export-ready artboards with tokens, spacing guides, and component notes.
* Component variants:
** Hero: default, hover CTA, reduced motion.
** Accordion: collapsed, expanding, expanded, error state (timeout), loading/skeleton.

h2. Assets
* SVG/PNG export set for:
** Release notes and marketing snippets (light and dark backgrounds).
** Docs screenshot masters (2x exports for retina).
* Annotated screenshot masters for Docs/Console.

h2. Motion spec
* Documented motion behavior:
** Triggers: initial load (one-time), hover/focus on hero CTA (subtle), accordion expand/collapse.
** Easing: standard “decelerate” for expand; “accelerate” for collapse.
** Durations:
*** Hero fold accent: 160–220ms (staggered), opacity 120ms.
*** Accordion expand: 200–260ms; collapse 160–220ms.
* Reduced motion: if prefers-reduced-motion is set, hero accent becomes static and accordion uses instant state changes (no animated height).

h1. Acceptance criteria (final)
1. Hero compositions (desktop/tablet/mobile) approved by PM and engineering with final copy and CTAs.
2. Figma frames contain export-ready artboards with component tokens and spacing guide.
3. Step accordion states (collapsed, expanding, expanded, error) include screen reader annotations and keyboard interaction notes.
4. Screenshot masters for Docs and Console match pixel guidelines and include 2x exports for retina.
5. Motion spec documented (duration/easing/triggers) and validated by frontend on staging implementation.
6. Performance check: hero animation does not exceed the 40ms jank budget on the standard Dedicated demo machine profile.
7. All assets uploaded to the release folder and linked from the engineering PR; final sign-off by Design Lead and PM.

h1. Implementation notes for engineering
h2. Responsive layout
* Breakpoints: use Console standard breakpoints (mobile ≤ 480, tablet 481–768, desktop ≥ 769).
* Hero height target: keep primary content + CTA visible without scrolling on 768px-tall viewports.
* Avoid layout shift: reserve hero illustration space with a fixed aspect-ratio container.

h2. Accordion interaction
* Header row is a button element.
* aria-expanded toggles with state.
* aria-controls references the region ID.
* Focus ring must be visible and meet contrast requirements.
* Support keyboard:
** Tab/Shift+Tab: normal navigation
** Enter/Space: toggle current item
** Up/Down arrows: move between accordion headers (optional but recommended)

h2. Error state
* If step content cannot load within 6s, show error state with:
** Short message
** Retry action
** Link to troubleshooting docs (if available)

h1. Accessibility requirements
* Color contrast:
** Body text meets 4.5:1
** Focus indicators meet 3:1 against adjacent colors
* Reduced motion support (see Motion spec).
* Screen reader notes:
** The accordion region must announce expanded/collapsed state changes.
** Ensure the hero decorative fold accents are aria-hidden.

h1. Screenshot capture runbook (QA + Docs)
h2. Naming convention
* quickstart-hero-[theme]-[breakpoint]-v2026-04.png
* quickstart-accordion-[state]-[theme]-[breakpoint]-v2026-04.png

h2. Capture guidelines
1. Use deterministic content:
* Use mocked API responses or seeded demo org to avoid flakiness in Docs screenshots.
2. Set viewport sizes:
* Desktop: 1440x900
* Tablet: 768x1024
* Mobile: 390x844
3. Use 2x export for retina.
4. Verify theme variants (light/dark) and ensure the CTA focus ring is visible.

h1. Handoff checklist
* [Design] Final Figma link includes:
** components + tokens
** annotations
** export settings
* [Design] Assets exported (SVG/PNG) and uploaded to the release folder.
* [Eng] Staging build validated for:
** responsive layout
** reduced motion
** keyboard navigation
** screen reader announcements
** performance (no visible jank)
* [PM] Copy and CTA labels approved.

h1. Timeline and release
* Intended release train: console-2026.04 (moved from console-2026.03 due to QA window and token parity checks).
* Final asset freeze: 2026-03-18.
* Doc last verified on staging: 2026-03-20.

h1. Change log
* 2026-02-26 — Kickoff: scoped minimal viable hero + accordion pattern. Prioritized space efficiency for enterprise consoles. (Avery Chen)
* 2026-03-02 — Internal critique: concept B (origami fold) selected; tightened type scale and increased CTA contrast. (Design)
* 2026-03-05 — Motion prototype validated; guidance to avoid JS-heavy animation. (Miguel Ortega)
* 2026-03-07 — Accessibility pass: updated tokens to meet contrast; added aria-expanded + focus ring notes; removed shortcut proposal later. (Priya Singh)
* 2026-03-10 — Engineering spike: resolved mobile reflow by changing accordion animation strategy. (Miguel Ortega)
* 2026-03-12 — PM review: subhead updated to emphasize predictable latency. (Elena Martens)
* 2026-03-21 — Final: removed Lottie deliverable, confirmed reduced-motion behavior, updated perf budget to 40ms, and published release-2026.04 asset set. (Avery Chen)

h1. Owners
* Design: Priya Singh (assignee), Avery Chen (author)
* Engineering: Miguel Ortega
* Product: Elena Martens
